en.headline: Extremely hot weather continues under Very Hot Weather Warning
en.dek: The Observatory said Tropical Cyclone Dolphin’s outer subsiding air will keep temperatures high today and tomorrow, with urban highs around 36°C and some New Territories areas reaching 37°C or above.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory kept the Very Hot Weather Warning in force on Monday morning as residual influence from Tropical Cyclone Dolphin continued to bring mainly fine and extremely hot conditions.

In a special weather tip issued at 4.50am, the Observatory said the cyclone was moving across eastern China and inland, and its outer subsiding air would keep extreme heat over the territory today and tomorrow, with temperatures in some areas reaching 37 degrees Celsius or above.

The local forecast called for mainly fine weather with a maximum of around 36 degrees in urban areas and a couple of degrees higher in the New Territories. Moderate west to northwesterly winds were expected, freshening on high ground at first. The maximum UV index was forecast at 11, indicating extreme intensity.
The Observatory advised the public to drink more water, take heat precautions and watch for symptoms of heat-related illness, especially among the elderly, children and those with chronic conditions.

zh.headline: 酷熱天氣警告仍然生效 極端酷熱持續
zh.dek: 天文台指熱帶氣旋白海豚外圍下沉氣流影響，今明兩日部分地區氣溫達37度或以上，市區最高約36度。
body: 天文台周一早上維持酷熱天氣警告生效，熱帶氣旋白海豚外圍下沉氣流繼續為本港帶來大致天晴及極端酷熱天氣。
天文台清晨4時50分發出特別天氣提示，指白海豚正橫過華東並移入內陸，其外圍下沉氣流會在今明兩日繼續帶來極端酷熱天氣，部分地區氣溫達37度或以上。
本地天氣預報指今日大致天晴，日間極端酷熱，市區最高氣溫約36度，新界再高一兩度；吹和緩西至西北風，初時高地風勢清勁。紫外線指數最高約11，屬極高水平。
天文台呼籲市民多補充水分及採取防暑措施，特別留意長者、小童及慢性病患者的健康狀況。
